_readme: External model-performance evidence for scripts/ops/optimize-pools.mjs.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the pool optimizer ranks members by performance first,
response time second, quota third. In-DB evidence is thin — arena Elo covers
only ~10% of pool members, and everything else falls back to a coarse catalog
proxy. This file is the seam for a gathering agent (or a human) to supply
real benchmark evidence.
HOW TO USE: point the optimizer at it with
PERFORMANCE_FILE=/app/data/model-performance.json
or copy it to the default path. Missing file => optimizer falls back to
arena Elo + catalog proxy and says so in its output.
MATCHING: 'model' is the BARE model leaf (no provider, no ':free'/'-free'),
matched case-insensitively against each pool member. 'nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free'
-> "nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b". Vendor prefixes are stripped:
'openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free' -> same leaf.
SCORING: 'scores.*' are normalized 0..1 and win over arena Elo and the proxy.
Prefer 'default' (else 'coding', else the mean of the given categories).
'metrics.*' are the RAW evidence a reviewer can audit — not used for ranking,
except ttftMs/outputTokensPerSec which fill response time when we have no
measured latency of our own.
HONESTY RULE: only include numbers you actually retrieved, and cite the source
in 'provenance'. Do not interpolate between models. An absent model is better
than an invented score.

provenance.note: Serving latency + throughput for free-tier models (portal table).
